title: example-targets runtime R2: the upstream-build route on example 105's two pinned commons-numbers commits, built by Maven and replayed in separate JVMs
description: The acceptance's upstream-build row: one real pinned revision built as a job. runtime.py's new upstream-build route (runtime_upstream.py) fetches each exact commit of apache/commons-numbers from github.com into an isolated checkout (no tags, hooks or user configuration; the recorded parent checked for after), and runs the recipe the positive stream's 105 sidecar records (mvn --projects commons-numbers-core ... package) with the installed Maven 3.10.0 by full path on JDK 11 by full path, with a settings file that makes Maven Central the one repository (a mirror of every other), a fresh local repository, --strict-checksums, HOME in the work directory and MAVEN_SKIP_RC. It checks that the build left every tracked file as checked out, takes the one produced non-auxiliary JAR holding ArithmeticUtils as the original, resolves the module's runtime dependencies with maven-dependency-plugin 3.9.0's build-classpath (none expected), and hashes every file the build resolved (maven/resolution.json). Then the case's own adapter and driver (runtime_numbers/, not 105's packet) run pow(int, int) in a separate JVM per commit on JDK 21 and 25 over 45 probes, read by an oracle written from the Javadoc. Step 2 deletes the two checkouts (and a failed build's local repository, which a successful one deletes itself) so that only the records come back.
expected: step 1 exits 0 and prints 'ok': prepare before and after artifacts-ready (checkout at e7c172d2 and 8cfc04e8, after's parent e7c172d2 checked, changedByBuild empty, original built/commons-numbers-core-1.4-SNAPSHOT.jar, no dependencies); four controls (before and after, JDK 21 and 25) exited 0 with 45 observations each; oracle problems exactly [-2, 31] on before and none on after; JDKs agree on each commit; ingestion at workflow's Phase 0 stub. Step 2 exits 0. A Maven failure is a build blocker with logs/build.log, recorded and read before any change

resources.notes: two Maven builds of one small module (commons-parent's plugins fetched from Central once, cached in each build's fresh local repository, so fetched twice), four short JVM runs; network to github.com and Maven Central
